## Professional Summary

Backend Engineer specializing in REST API design, authentication systems (JWT, OAuth 2.0, RBAC), payment integrations (Stripe, Apple App Store, Google Play), and PostgreSQL database architecture. 4+ years of experience leading backend development of mobile applications in production with thousands of monthly active users.

## Experience

**The Bubble Hub** — Backend Engineer (April 2024 – April 2026)
- Led backend development for Prodigy Padel Academy and Koru Acne
- REST API design (OpenAPI/Swagger), JWT, RBAC, OAuth 2.0 (Google, Apple)
- Payment integrations: Stripe, Apple App Store IAP, Google Play IAP
- Gamification systems: points, levels, achievements, leaderboards
- PostgreSQL architecture, Redis rate limiting
- CI/CD with Azure DevOps
- Stack: ASP.NET Core, Azure Functions, PostgreSQL, Redis

**Ernst & Young (EY)** — Technology and Security Consultant (April 2022 – April 2024)
- Backend development and SecDevOps for enterprise clients
- SIEM engineering within a SOC (Splunk, QRadar, ElasticSearch)
- Led SIEM platform migrations and developed detection rules processing millions of daily events
